title: Planted q-ary Multiproduct K-Copy Dual-Tensor Bridge: Primal-Difference Shift Cancellation, Constant-Sum Dual Fiber Spectral Decomposition, and K-Invariant Coset Purity

theorems.name: Exact Two-Copy Disentanglement and Shift Cancellation into |psi_B>
theorems.statement: For any dimension-d subspace B in F_q^n and shift a in F_q^n, the modular subtraction unitary U_sub|x_1, x_2> = |x_1, (x_2 - x_1) mod q> maps |psi_(B+a)> tensor |psi_(B+a)> to the exact product state |psi_(B+a)> tensor |psi_B>.

theorems.name: Orthonormal Constant-Sum Dual Fiber Decomposition of Shift-Averaged K-Copy State
theorems.statement: Averaging the K-copy Fourier state QFT_q^(tensor nK) |psi_(B+a)>^(tensor K) over uniform a ~ Unif(F_q^n) diagonalizes the density operator into q^(n-d) orthonormal constant-sum fiber projectors |Phi_(B^perp)^(K)(s_perp)><Phi_(B^perp)^(K)(s_perp)| indexed by s_perp = u_1 + ... + u_K mod q in B^perp, each supported on q^((K-1)(n-d)) tuples.

theorems.name: Exact K-Invariance of Coset-Ensemble Rank, Spectrum, and Purity
theorems.statement: For every copy count K >= 1, the shift-averaged K-copy state rho_bar_B^(K) = E_(a ~ F_q^n)[(|psi_(B+a)><psi_(B+a)|)^(tensor K)] has exact rank q^(n-d), non-zero eigenvalues all equal to q^(-(n-d)), and purity Tr((rho_bar_B^(K))^2) = q^(-(n-d)) independent of K.
